ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface with a low white-to-black pixel ratio (estimated <5% high-intensity pixels).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field with sparse high-intensity (white) punctate spots. Notable high-intensity white ring-shaped cluster on the right lobe and localized white mottling concentrated along the right trailing edge and median notch border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 60-70 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total visible fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge is predominantly linear with minimal pixel-amplitude variation. Right trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations consisting of 5-7 distinct peaks and deep valleys/indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a linear diagonal upward sweep. The right lobe follows a complex curve with a mid-section concavity followed by an upward convex sweep toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of light-brown and white pixels (mass) at the terminal tip of the left lobe. Discrete white punctate clusters scattered on the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, white linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe surface, specifically diagonal and horizontal rake-like marks near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge; heavy external mass (barnacle colonization) at the distal left tip; distinct white annular (ring) scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique white circular ring mark (approximately 15-20 pixels in diameter) located on the lateral section of the right lobe.
